item.title: Downtown West Palm Beach road closures begin Thursday for 4th on Flagler celebration
item.description: Several roads in downtown West Palm Beach will close beginning at 4 p.m. Thursday and remain closed through Sunday for the annual 4th on Flagler celebration.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse will host a full day of Independence Day activities on July 4, including a pool party, live music and a 9 p.m. fireworks finale.

item.title: Meta complies with Florida youth social media law while TikTok, Google face enforcement action
item.description: Attorney General James Uthmeier said Meta has suspended hundreds of thousands of underage accounts and is complying with Florida's social media law, but TikTok and Google have stayed silent on their compliance plans.

item.title: Martin County free clinic sees surge in patients after ACA subsidies expire, has capacity for more
item.description:
Volunteers in Medicine in Martin County is treating more patients after enhanced subsidies through the Affordable Care Act expired at the start of 2026, leaving many people without health insurance. The clinic serves low-income families and provides free medical care with no strings attached.
